requirements.title: Control loop shall enter a safe state on sensor timeout
requirements.body: If the primary speed sensor has no valid sample for the configured timeout, the controller shall command a safe state.

requirements.title: Diagnostic event shall be recorded for timeout transition
requirements.body: A diagnostic event shall be recorded when the safe-state transition is triggered by sensor timeout.

change_request.title: Change timeout handling from fixed threshold to configurable threshold
change_request.body: The sensor timeout threshold becomes configurable per product profile.

standards.title: Fictional standard clause: bidirectional traceability
standards.summary: Safety-relevant software requirements should be traceable to design and verification evidence.

standards.title: Fictional standard clause: change impact analysis
standards.summary: A behavior-changing software modification should identify affected requirements, tests, and risk controls.

sops.title: Fictional SOP: software change impact review
sops.summary: Review affected requirements, design elements, verification cases, and unresolved assumptions before implementation.
